description: This file imports the 'defineSetupPluginEntry' function from the openclaw plugin SDK core module, and an internal 'zaloPlugin' from a local module. It then exports the result of calling 'defineSetupPluginEntry' with 'zaloPlugin' as an argument, indicating it serves as a setup entry point for registering or initializing the zalo plugin within the openclaw framework.

methods.name: defineSetupPluginEntry
methods.description: Function imported from openclaw/plugin-sdk/core used to define the setup plugin entry point.
